# Herzing College Blog

> > Career-focused blog from Herzing College covering vocational training programs, skilled trades, healthcare education, and professional development across Canadian campuses in Winnipeg, Montreal, Ottawa, and Toronto.

The Herzing College Blog provides insights into career training programs, industry trends, and student success stories. Content spans healthcare, skilled trades (HVAC, electrical, network cabling), business administration, design, mental health certification through Kompass Professional Development, and alternative dispute resolution (ADR) careers.

## Key Topics

- Herzing College programs and campuses
- Kompass Professional Development
- Skilled trades training (HVAC, electrical, network cabling)
- Healthcare education (Health Care Aide, mental health)
- Community Mental Health and Addictions certificate
- Alternative Dispute Resolution (mediation, arbitration)
- Career training and professional development
- Winnipeg, Montreal, Ottawa, Toronto campuses
- Pre-apprenticeship programs
- AI and automation impact on careers
- Interior design and green building
- Occupational health and safety
- Early Childhood Education (ECE)
- Administrative assistant skills
- Canadian Mental Health Association partnerships

## Career Programs & Training

- [AI and Accounting: Artificial Intelligence's Impact on the Profession](https://blog.herzing.ca/how-automation-is-changing-not-eliminating-accounting-jobs): AI's impact on accounting careers: automation, skills & opportunities
- [Explore the Early Childhood Education Program at Herzing College](https://blog.herzing.ca/inside-herzings-early-childhood-education-program): ECE program overview with instructor Marjolaine Jeanty: courses & internship
- [How Do You Become an Interior Designer in Canada?](https://blog.herzing.ca/how-do-you-become-an-interior-designer-tips-advice): Interior designer career path in Canada: training, portfolio & skills
- [What an Interior Designer Does (& Doesn't Do) at Work](https://blog.herzing.ca/what-an-interior-designer-does-doesnt-do-at-work): Interior designer job duties, daily tasks & common misconceptions
- [4 Administrative Assistant Qualities Every Employer Wants](https://blog.herzing.ca/qualities-every-employer-wants-in-an-administrative-assistant): 4 essential administrative assistant skills employers value most
- [Occupational Health & Safety Careers to Explore](https://blog.herzing.ca/occupational-health-and-safety-jobs-explore-your-options): OHS career options in Canada: jobs, requirements & workplace safety skills
